reports.headline: The Pack Has a Master
reports.body: The skinless dogs are back in the grazing land {dir} of the village {dist}, bigger than before, and now something walks with them: {name} says it has a mouth where its chest should be. The {animal} are gone.

reports.headline: Howling, and Something Worse
reports.body: Last night the howling {dir} of here {dist} stopped all at once, and then something laughed. {name} found the fence torn out and tracks too wide for any dog.
